body:
# Independent audit of the sharp planar two-tail chord

Audited source:
`candidate 66cd3b069de31436`, Sections1--6.

**Result: PASS.** The proof is an exact one-density theorem and does not
assert simultaneous realization of different normal directions.

* The Stieltjes convention for the right derivative agrees with the
  integration identity. Subtracting the endpoint chord gives the stated
  Green kernel. Enlarging the interval increases that kernel, so monotone
  convergence is valid even for infinite unweighted endpoint curvature.
* The factor p(1-p)/2 in the tent probability measure is exact. Tonelli
  normalizes its total mass to one. Nonnegative finite concave functions
  have the claimed bounded continuous representative after replacing
  only their endpoint values, leaving both tails unchanged.
* Eliminating p from the two tent tails gives all three formulas for F.
  The middle derivative decreases between exactly the two outer slopes.
  The positive chord gaps on the outer intervals and concavity in the
  middle show strict gap at every interior peak, so equality forces
  precisely the affine endpoint mixture.
* The lower-bound-only tail statement retains the feasibility interval
  and handles its endpoint case correctly. The positive-part term does
  not combine two different cone extremizers.
* Coarea normalization in the actual planar-body application includes
  the norm of the height functional. The coefficient in equation(11)
  is exactly x(1-x)/(y(1-y)). Its stated domain excludes the degenerate
  coinciding or endpoint tail parameters.
* The affine-section equality case forces both section endpoints to be
  affine by their opposite Jensen inequalities; hence its trapezoid
  classification is justified. It is correctly scoped to one direction.
* The upper envelope follows by a tangent-line inequality for the same
  tent distribution. Mixing the unique tent at prescribed B with the
  affine density at the same B realizes the entire vertical interval.
  The stated tangent contact sets give the upper equality cases,
  including both join points.

No repair is needed. The two diagnostic scalar menus in the companion
all-level note remain subject to its later whole-A and cross-direction
exclusions; this audit supplies no claim that either is an actual fiber
configuration.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
